summary: A fire on Line 2 at Shakti Components Pvt Ltd has halted production. PO-1001 (4000 units of Bracket 501, due 2026-12-03) and PO-1002 (2500 units, due 2026-12-04) are affected, with total exposure of INR 491400.00. Current inventory of 1900 units across two locations provides only 1.5 days of coverage against combined daily demand of 750 units, resulting in shortages for both orders. The biggest unknown is when the supplier will restart production.
facts: SUP-1008 (Shakti Components Pvt Ltd) is a Packaging supplier based in Pune with status OPEN.
PO-1001 was ordered on 2026-11-02 with expected delivery 2026-12-03, status OPEN, for 4000 units of ITM-501 (Bracket 501) at INR 75.60 per unit.
PO-1002 was ordered on 2026-11-02 with expected delivery 2026-12-04, status OPEN, for 2500 units of ITM-501 at INR 75.60 per unit.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-CHENNAI: 800 units on hand, 100 reserved, 200 safety stock, 150 daily demand.
ITM-501 inventory at DC-PUNE: 1100 units on hand, 200 reserved, 300 safety stock, 600 daily demand.
SUP-2001 is a qualified alternate supplier for ITM-501 with 2 days lead time, INR 84.00 unit price, and 5000 units capacity.
SUP-2002 is a qualified alternate supplier for ITM-501 with 5 days lead time and INR 79.50 unit price.
SUP-1008 capacity per week is not provided in the ERP system.
SUP-2002 capacity for ITM-501 is not provided in the ERP system.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 delivery will be delayed by 2 days from its due date of 2026-12-03.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 2 for PO-1001.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 delivery will be delayed by 1 day from its due date of 2026-12-04.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows estimated_delay_days of 1 for PO-1002.

estimates.statement: PO-1001 will cause a shortage of ITM-501.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows shortage: true for PO-1001, with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5 against the delay.

estimates.statement: PO-1002 will cause a shortage of ITM-501.
estimates.basis: Impact calculation shows shortage: true for PO-1002, with inventory_coverage_days of 1.5 against the delay.

assumptions: The outage duration of 48 hours stated in the event is accurate.
Daily demand rates for ITM-501 at both locations will remain constant during the disruption period.
Reserved inventory quantities cannot be used to cover the shortage.
The fire damage is limited to Line 2 and does not affect other production lines or inventory at the supplier.
